comment: No module in this plugin calls appendContextMenu and none carries menu wording, so there are no menu lines to write. Checked against the maker's source at tag 2.0.1, which is the installed version. D_Inf sets its output channel count from the input's, so an unpatched input leaves the output with no channels; that is what the D_Inf note rests on. The Tachyon Entangler sync defaults were already recorded in the two sync control lines and are repeated as a note because they decide how the module sounds the moment it is added.
